title: Read and write custom project option values
summary: Adds, modifies, reads and deletes custom section/key/value parameters in the focused project's options storage (IOptionsStorage external parameters), including the null return for a missing key.
phrasings: store a custom setting in a project
save key value data with a PrjPcb
read an external parameter from project options

commands.name: AddUserParameter
commands.description: Add a user parameter to the focused project's options

commands.name: ReadUserParameter
commands.description: Read a user parameter from the focused project's options

commands.name: DeleteUserParameter
commands.description: Delete a user parameter from the focused project's options
